intro: Create groups and add members. Snippets set to "Group only" are visible only to members of that group. Add people by username or email; an email without an account becomes an invite, which lets that person sign up even when registration is closed.

members.title: Members of {{name}}
members.addHint: Unknown emails are saved as invites and join the group on their first Google sign-in.

confirmationModal.title: Delete group
confirmationModal.message: Delete this group? Its snippets become private to their owners. This cannot be undone.
